reason: After Tyler's review, the user corrected the schematic: C13 pin 2 is GND, while U1 HIDRV1 and Q7 gate share their own net. Native netlist and PCB parity confirm this topology.

Fabrication review found the cell-count divider return isolated; join it to GND as specified by BQ25730 datasheet.
ST RM0038 specifies VLCD tied to VDDA when LCD is unused. VDDA is on +3.3V in this design.
